scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid starting an icy morning e-bike commute with a rear brake that likely needs attention.
Emerging Need: A broad winter-riding advisory is only background; later schedule pressure, transit disruption, brake symptoms, and a brief shop queue align into a preventable riding risk.
Decision Context: Observable updates establish the morning route pressure and cutoff, while the saved bike note contains the deferred rear-pad detail, intake route, and no-paid-upgrade preference needed to interpret the symptoms.
Consequence: Timely attention can preserve a same-morning safety check or safer plan; after the queue locks and the ride begins, the intended prevention is no longer achievable.

parameter.subject: Freeze-thaw grit advisory for Tuesday riders
parameter.body: Minneapolis paths are expected to refreeze overnight. Wet grit can make disc brakes chirp briefly, so riders should monitor stopping distance and get service if symptoms persist. This is a general riding advisory, not a product recall or route closure.

parameter.title: Early supply handoff shift
parameter.description: Arrive by 08:20. Planned e-bike segment to Lake Street transit because the direct bus backup would be too slow for the handoff.

parameter.content: When you braked by the bike room tonight, I heard the back wheel chirp pretty loudly. Also, the Route 9 detour alerts are back for tomorrow morning, so that backup may be messy.

parameter.subject: Black-ice morning: limited commuter brake triage 7:15-7:45
parameter.body: Riverwheel will run a quick visual brake-safety triage line for commuters from 7:15 to 7:45 today. Notes received before 7:30 help staff pull prior service records; after the line fills, the next standby checks begin after noon. Triage is an estimate only and does not authorize repair work.

parameter.content: Riverwheel just put a sign on the door saying the pre-work brake triage line is locked and the next callbacks start after noon. I also saw you roll out from the bike room toward the Greenway a few minutes ago.
